name: Jyoti Shankar Panda “Hayat”

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Jyoti Shankar Panda “Hayat” is represented here by the Hindi poem “गीतकवि की व्यथा,” a sustained address from a poet to the public. Its recurring plea for forgiveness measures artistic success against the suffering the speaker has failed to share.

Each stanza adds another thing imagined as sold: tears, love, truth, the self, light and finally the rights of others. The repeated return home contrasts private comfort with collective deprivation, turning the song into a searching argument about the responsibilities of writing.
